title: RepoGovernanceRuleFinding
description: Named rule evaluation result for repo governance. Records rule ID/version, antecedents, consequents, blockers, and evaluation disposition. Findings are NOT policy decisions and do NOT authorize action — they produce policy-decision requests.

antecedents.description: Observation refs that form the rule's antecedent conditions.

consequents.description: What follows if the rule fires: bounded action classes or policy request types.

blockers.description: Conditions that block this finding from producing an action candidate.

policy_decision_required.description: If true, a policy-decision request must be approved before any action candidate is emitted.

policy_decision_request_ref.description: Ref to the emitted policy-decision request artifact.

action_candidate_ref.description: Only present if policy approval has been received. Never populated before approval.

rdf_graph_ref.description: RDF named graph the rule was evaluated over.

replay_instructions.description: Instructions for deterministically replaying this rule evaluation.

action_candidate_ref.description: action_candidate_ref must not be present if policy approval has not been granted
